description: The dataset model's wire conformance corpus. SELF-ENUMERATED: each family's 'vectors' is authoritative, and the suite fails on a vector on disk the manifest does not count as surely as on a counted one that is missing. Accept vectors are canonical texts: each decodes and re-encodes to its own bytes, with no trailing newline. Reject vectors name the code the decoder must refuse them with.

families.description: Model states in the versioned envelope: the worked retail model, the same with a table retired, a model seeded from a reported schema, and an empty model.

One op per kind: add (a leaf and a subtree), amend (a rename, a limit), retire; then an amend to a limit declaring every optional cost cap (Phase 1902), whose four fields are written only when declared; then an amend to a source declaring a row-count fingerprint (Phase 2008), whose field is written only when declared; then an amend to the model marking a classification recordable (Phase 1903), whose field is written only when it names one; then an amend to a column stating a unit, a label and a description (Phase 2), in Core's field spelling, each written only when stated.
Texts the decoder refuses, each with its code.
The connection record (Phase 1903): one op per kind, the first of each in the worked sessions, numbered in the vocabulary's order.

Worked sessions as canonical JSONL chains (SHA-256, no trailing newline): one over a model marking only 'public' recordable, whose personal request is recorded with its values withheld, and one marking every classification recordable. Each reads, verifies, folds and re-writes to its own bytes.

Session texts the reader refuses, each with its code: a torn tail, a rewound head (against the head the vector names), a broken chain, a verified chain the reducer refuses, and op texts the codec refuses.

The model projected per peer (Phase 1907): the worked retail model projected for a subject with nothing, for one reading public columns row by row, and for one also reading personal columns in aggregate. No physical identifier, row policy, limit or withheld classification appears in any of them.

Texts the projection codec refuses, each with its code: four that decode as a model but are not a projection (a physical identifier, a row policy, the whole model, a grant over a classification the model does not declare), an unknown grant level, another version, a missing field, and a dataset model state.
